༄༅// rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga dpal 'byor rgya mtsho'i 'don brjod la nye bar mkho ba'i zur rgyan mtshar sdug 'gram chang zhes bya ba bzhugs so// mdo sngags lam mchog mchog dman bar ma'i blor// gang 'tsham smra mkhas mkhas dbang nyin mor byed// ji snyed dkyil 'khor 'khor lo kun gyi gtso// phrin las kun khyab khyab bdag bla mas skyongs// srid zhi'i dge legs legs byas rdzogs ldan mgron// gnyer ba'i thabs mchog mchog gi rten gsum la// mchod yul yongs 'dus 'dus skur mngon 'gyur ba// rab tu gnas tshul tshul bzhin shes las 'byung*// 'on te gsang chen cho ga'i ba ku la// bab col sor mos kha 'byed rtsol na yang*// dpyod ldan dgyes pa'i 'dab brgya ma grol bar// legs bshad mtshar sdug 'gram pa'i chang 'di brtsam// de la rab gnas don gsal dang bkra shis rgya mtsho gnyis kyi dgongs don ston pa'i bstan bcos dpal 'byor rgya mtsho'i cho ga ste/ de la'ang*/ rten dang slob dpon dus dang gnas// yo byad cho ga bzang po drug /ces 'byung ba ltar bzang po drug ldan gyi rab gnas bgyid pa la/ kye rdo rje'i sgrub mchod dang sbrel ba'i tshe nyin gsum par 'gyur la/ sgrub mchod dang ma 'brel ba'i tshe nyin gcig par 'gyur ba yin te/ dang po ltar na/ legs bsham bdag bskyed bum pa bzlas// rten sbyong bkru zhing phyi ba dang*// rten bskyed ye shes spyan drangs la// bgegs bskrad mchod de dgug gzhug bya// rgyas gdab mchod bstod gtor ma gtang*// snyan gsan dbab cing mchod bstod bya// bzod par gsol zhing gshegs su gsol// rten dgab bdag bsrung sta gon no// zhes pa ltar las/ dang po legs bsham ni/ dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod la dgos pa/ sta gon dang dngos gzhi'i cho ga la dgos pa rnams spyi ltar dang*/ rab gnas la dgos pa/ rab tu gnas bya'i rten gyi gtso bo zhal shar du phyogs par bzhugs su gsol ba'i mdun du khrus stegs ji skad bshad pa ltar bris pa bkram pa'i dbus su man 'ji'i khar/

rten rnying pa rab gnas can dang*/ ring bsrel rdo rje de dang nye bar me long la gur gum gyis rten 'brel snying po sogs bris pa bzhugs su gsol/ de'i phyogs mtshams kyi pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad la bum pa brgyad/ de dang nye bar dūr ba'i pir dang 'dag chal rnams dang*/ de'i g.yon du dkyus nas 'byung ba ltar bris pa'i mnga' dbul stegs dang bcas pa rnams bsham/ nyin dang po nas rab tu gnas par bya ba'i rten rnams ni/ sgrub mchod sta gon gyi dus nas bsham/ sgrub mchod sta gon ni sngon 'gro gtor ma nas bzung bdag mdun sgrub pa sogs nas dge ba bsngo ba'i bar kye rdor sgrub mchod kyi skabs ji lta ba bzhin las/ rab gnas la gdon bya lhag po ci yang med/ gnyis pa bdag bskyed ces pa ni/ nyin gnyis pa'i sngon 'gro gtor ma nas bdag bskyed sgrub mchod dngos gzhi kye rdor sgrub mchod tsam byed pa'am/ rgyas pa na bdag 'jug dbang len pa/ dam tshig gsum gyi glu blang ba dang bcas pa grub par bya'o// de la bdag bskyed kyi sngon du 'gro ba srung ba'i 'khor lo'i bsgom bzlas byas nas/ su gang dag bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma sogs kyi dmod pa 'dor ba'i tshig dang bcas pa ngag tu brjod mod kyi/ 'dir rgyas pa'am bkra shis pa'i las yin pas/ de'i tshe thal mo brdab pa ni mi bya'o zhes phyag len du'ang de ltar du byed pa snang ngo*// de la dpyad par bya ba 'di ltar snang ste/ de ltar na thal mo brdab pa'i bar du gnod byed btsir ba'i dmigs pa tsam 'gog pa tsam ma zad de/ phyir bzlog gi bsgom bzlas gzhan rnams kyang 'gog dgos pa'i phyir/ de chos can rgyas pa'am/ bkra shis pa'i las la de dag byar mi rigs te/ srung 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa bsgoms nas hūm̐ zhes brjod cing 'khor lo g.yon skor du bskor ba dang*/ phyogs mtshams kyi khro bo rnams zhal phyir gzigs su bsgom pa/

gtso bo dang steng 'og gi khro bo rnams zhabs g.yas brkyang du bsgyur ba/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs bar du gnod byed dgug bstim byas nas gtubs pa'i dmigs pa su gang dag ces dmod pa dor ba'i gdon bya dang bcas pa gsod gcod kyi las yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ thal brdebs gcig pu 'gog na de dag kyang 'gog dgos pa mtshungs te/ gsod gcod kyi bsam sbyor yod pa mtshungs pa'i phyir/ rgyu mtshan yod de/ rje btsun gong ma brgyud par bcas pas gsungs pa'i sgrub thabs kyi sngon 'gro'i rang srung ba'i 'khor lo yod pa nyid nyams su blangs pas chog gis/ gnod pa phyir bzlog gi bsgom bzlas la thal brdebs tsam dor ba'i gzu lum gyi bya ba de 'dra mi dgos pa'i phyir/ 'o na ji ltar bgyi snyam pa bshad par bya ste/ rten srung ba'i 'khor lo thun mong ba'i nang du thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor bsgoms nas/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra rak+ṣa hūm̐ bh+rūṃ hūm̐/ lan gsum gyis brtan par bya ba yan chad 'dra bar byas la/ 'khor lo'i nang gi dbus dang phyogs bcur pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re/ de rnams kyi steng du hūm̐ re re/ de yang lho'i dkar po/ nub kyi dmar po/ steng gi ser po/ gzhan thams cad sngon po/ de thams cad so so'i gnas su yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su rang nyid hūm̐ mdzad sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu rang gi phyag rgyas thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ shar du gshin rje gshed sngon po sogs nas nub byang du stobs po che sngon po rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba ser po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ 'og tu gnod mdzes sngon po gtun shing 'dzin pa/ hūm̐ mdzad ma yin pa thams cad sogs nas gzhan thams cad la mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan zhes yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed pa'i bar 'dra bar brjod/ de nas 'khor lo g.yas su 'khor bar bsam zhing*/ khro bo dang srung ba'i 'khor lo las me 'od phyogs bcur 'phros pas/

rnal 'byor bsgom pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad cing shul thams cad me lces khyab par gyur ces brjod cing bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis brtan par bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni/ rang nyid hūm̐ mdzad 'od du zhu ba las e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa sogs dkyus ltar byas pas grub bo// rab gnas sta gon la/ bum pa bzlas pa ni/ lha'i bum pa ni sngar sgrub mchod dus nas bsgrubs zin pas mi dgos la/ khrus bum rnams dkyus nas 'byung ba ltar bsgrub bo// bzhi pa rten sbyong ba ni/ tshogs pa mang po yod na/ langs te rten rnams la zhi ba/ phyed ma/ drag po'i sbyong ba gsum bya/ gdan la bzhugs te til sbyong dang bcas pa bya'o// lnga pa khrus ni/ rten rnying pa la ji ltar bltams pa sogs sh+lau ka gsum sngags dang bcas pas khrus gsol nas/ khrus chu de khrus bum brgyad du cung zad blugs la/ rten gsar pa bkru ba'i tshe/ me long gi ngos su gzugs brnyan 'char du bcug la/ rgyal ba'i sku la sogs sh+lau ka gcig dang*/ kā ya bi sho dha ni zhes pa'i sngags lan gsum brjod cing*/ dang por dri'i til mar gyis byugs/ de nas shun lpags kyis nye/ dūrba'i pir gyis drud/ chu gtsang mas kyang bkru/ de nas dri'i bum pas 'di ni khrus mchog sogs sngags dang bcas pas bkru/ de dag sku la sogs sngags dang bcas pas khrus dar gyis sku phyi ba'i tshul bya/ de bzhin du 'og ma thams cad kyi 'gor rgyal ba'i sku la zhes pa sbyar ba dang*/ sngags lan gsum dang*/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis mngar gsum gyi bum pa la sogs pa nas khrus bum gzhan rnams kyis kyang bkru ba rnams dkyus ltar dang*/ me tog 'thor ba dang bcas te/ gang la ser sna sogs shis brjod kyi mthar/

slar yang dri'i bum pas/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs kyis bkru/ de dag sku la sogs kyis sku phye ba rnams ni khrus so// drug pa rten bskyed pa ni/ lha khang bshig dbral sogs mi dgos pa'i rigs la las bum gyi chu dang*/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs las sngags kyis bsang*/ shūn+ya tās sbyangs/ lha khang mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūṃ las 'khor lo bh+rūṃ gyis mtshan pa las rnam par snang mdzad kye rdo rje sku mdog dkar po sogs nas rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ de lta bu'i rnam snang zhu ba las byung ba'i lha khang rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gtsug lag khang ngam lha khang gru bzhi pa sgo dang bcas pa/ ba gam dang pu shu dang rgyal mtshan dang 'phan la sogs pas brgyan pa'i gtsug lag khang ngam lha khang gi rnam pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ de lta bu'i lha khang gi dbus su seṅge'i khri/ shar du glang po che'i khri/ lhor rta'i khri/ nub tu rma bya'i khri/ byang du mkha' lding rnams kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du/ dbus su bh+rūṃ las 'khor lo bh+rūṃ gyis mtshan pa las rnam par snang mdzad kye rdo rje sku mdog dkar po/ zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad sogs nas don grub kyi bar yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang gu gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ thams cad kyang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ de'i byang shar du gur gyi mgon po lcam dral la sogs pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams dang*/ shar lhor rnam thos sras dang*/ nor rgyun ma dang*/ dzam+bha la la sogs pa nor lha'i tshogs rnams dang*/ gzhan yang de dag gi mtha' skor du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba zhes dang*/ sku rten rnams bsang sbyangs/

sku'i rten thams cad mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las rdo rje oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa las rdo rje 'chang kye rdo rje sku mdog dkar po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad rdo rje/ g.yon brgyad de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ gsung gi rten rnams bsang sbyangs/ gsung gi rten thams cad mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ dz+rīṃ las pad+ma dz+riṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od dpag med kye rdo rje sku mdog dmar po zhal brgyad sogs nas brgyan pa/ phyag mtshan la sogs pa'i thugs kyi rten rnams bsang sbyangs/ thugs kyi rten rnams mi dmigs te sogs nas/ hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las mi bskyod pa kye rdo rje sku mdog sngon po sogs nas brgyan pa/ mchod rten rnams bsang sbyangs/ mchod rten rnams mi dmigs te sogs nas/ gong gi lha khang gi skabs bzhin du rnam snang du bskyed la/ rnam snang zhu ba las byung ba'i chos sku'i mchod rten so sor bskyed pa'am mi nus na/ mchod rten tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ mchod rten rnams kyi bum pa rnams kyi nang du/ dbus su seṅge'i khri sogs nas/ so so'i sa bon phyag mtshan dang bcas pa las kye rdo rje rigs lnga 'khor bcas gong lha khang gi skabs ji lta ba bzhin bskyed do// srung 'khor yod na/ bsang sbyangs/ srung 'khor rnams mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje rwa nyi shu pa sogs nas rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa kyi bar thun mong ba'i srung 'khor bskyed/

de lta bu'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang gi dbus dang phyogs mtshams su bkod pa'i yi ge'i gnas rnams su paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dz+rīṃ las pad+ma dz+rīṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od dpag med kye rdo rjer bskyed/ gtsug lag khang gi gan 'ji ra dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa dmigs bsal gyis bskyed dgos tshe/ rin chen 'byung ldan kye rdo rjer bskyed na rten 'brel gyi legs pa mngon no// de nas lha de thams cad kyi mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs kyis skye mched byin gyis brlabs/ bdun pa ye shes pa spyan drang ba ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min gyi gnas sogs nas oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes dang*/ tshogs pa mang po yod na langs te rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ma lus 'gro ba'i rang bzhin sogs nas dṛ sh+ya hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ zhes pa'i bar brjod/ yungs kar thogs te/ ye shes sems dpa'i phyi bzhin du nas song shig ces pa'i bar/ rol mo dang a mṛ ta brjod pas phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ gdan la bzhugs te/ yon chab khrus chab gdan bcas 'bul/ mchod pa me tog nas/ sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig dang shab+da āḥhūm̐ zhes rol mo'i bar 'bul la/ dgug gzhug ni/ oṃ badz+ra gau ri sogs sgo ba bzhi'i sngags dang*/ rdor dril dang bcas pa'i phyag rgyas dgug bstim bya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes mang du brjod pas kyang bcug rang bzhin gyi gnas na bzhugs pa rnams la slar yang rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas sogs nas rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgya dang rdor dril 'dzin pas ji ltar sangs rgyas sogs tshigs bcad sngags dang bcas pas kyang lan gsum du dgug bstim bya'o// brgyad pa rgyas gdab pa ni/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po sogs kyis byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon sogs kyis dbang lha spyan drangs/

oṃ pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod nas/ gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis dbang bskur bas lha thams cad kyi sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ sku'i rten rnams la rdo rje sems dpa'/ gsung gi rten rnams la 'od dpag med/ thugs kyi rten rnams la mi bskyod pa/ rigs lnga la rigs lnga so sos dbur brgyan zhes brjod/ gong gi bskyed chog dang mthun par rgyas gdab kyang 'di tsam brjod pas 'thus so// dgu pa mchod bstod bya ba ni/ mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlabs nas dag cing dri med sogs tshigs bcad lnga dang bcas pas mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rje sogs de nyid lnga pas bstod/ gtor ma'i cho ga ni mdun bskyed dang 'brel bas dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod kyi skabs bzhin/ yi dam nas mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi bar gyis 'bul zhing*/ phrin las zhu ba'i skabs su/ rab tu gnas par byas pa'i rten rnams byin rlabs che ba/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i bshad sgrub dar ba/ 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba/ bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor dbang phyug legs pa'i yon tan thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i phrin las dang stong grogs rgya chen po mdzad du gsol zhes pa lta bu'i rgyas pa'i phrin las gang 'dod pa zhu/ sbyin sreg byed na/ zhi rgyas gang rung logs su 'byung ba ltar bya'o// bcu pa snyan gsan dbab cing mchod bstod byas la/ rten la bcug pa'i ye shes pa rnams nang par dngos gzhi'i dus su rten byin gyis rlobs pa'i phyir 'byon par zhu snyam pas/ spos dang rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ye shes 'khor lo bcom ldan 'das/ rig sngags rgyal por sogs lan gsum brjod de bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du sogs nas mchog stsal du gsol zhes pa'i bar brjod la mchod bstod bya/

bcu gcig pa bzod par gsol zhing gshegs su gsol ba ni/ yi ge brgya pa dang ma 'byor pa sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ oṃ badz+ro t+tiṣ+ṭha zhes dang rdo rje shugs kyi phyag rgyas rten gyi ye shes pa rnams phye ste mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur zhes brjod la mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig bya'o// bcu gnyis pa rten dgab pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra was+t+rā ya āḥhūm̐ gis rten gyi gtso bo rnams na bza' ser pos dgab la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs kyis bsrung*/ bcu gsum pa bdag bsrung ba ni/ mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi rjes chog gi mchod bstod dang*/ dngos grub blang ba/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa brtan bzhugs bya/ rten med pa rnams gshegs su gsol nas dam tshig pa rnams rang la thim zhes dang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang gi mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs kyis bsrungs nas dge ba bsngo ba rnams byas nas/ sang nyin mkho ba'i mchod gtor rnams bshams nas nyal ba'i rnal 'byor nyams su len pa rnams ni rab tu gnas pa'i sta gon gyi cho ga'o// nyin gsum par rab gnas kyi dngos gzhi la/ tho rangs bdag bskyed mdun bskyed mchod// rten sbyang bkru zhing phyi ba dang*// ring bsrel gzhug cing gsol ba gdab// rten bskyed spyan drangs dgug rgyas gdab// dbang bskur mchod bstod spyan dbye bya// gsol gdab mnga' dbul rgyas par bya// de yang mchod bstod bye brag dang*// sbyin sreg sngags te dngos gzhi'o// zhes pa ltar las/ dang po ni tho rengs ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis langs te/ sngon 'gro gtor ma btang nas/ bdag bskyed mdun bskyed sgrub mchod/ bdag mjug dbang len pa dam tshig gsum gyi glu blang ba'i bar dbang chu ltar bya/ gnyis pa rten sbyang ba ni/ rab gnas kyi khrus bum bsgrubs nas/ rten la sbyang pa'i rim pa rnams dang*/ gsum pa bkru zhing phyi ba ni/

khrus kyi rim pa rnams sta gon gyi dus ji lta ba bzhin bya'o// bzhi pa ring bsrel gzhug pa ni/ oṃ sarba bid+yā swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ ye dharmā dang*/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhes pa rnams sbrel te lan gsum brjod do// lnga pa gsol gdab ni/ thams cad langs te rdor dril dang me tog thogs te/ gang 'di bcom ldan 'das sogs sde tshan bzhi po re re zhing lan gsum re thub pa'i gzungs sngags dang yi dam gyi rtsa sngags aṣ+ṭa bzla zhing rol mo dang bcas te me tog 'thor/ de nas gdan la 'dug ste/ rten rab tu gnas par byas pa la brten nas sems can thams cad la phan bde bla na med pa bsgrub par bgyi'o snyam pa byang chub tu sems cung zad bsgoms nas/ ngag tu ngo mtshar chen po grangs med pa sogs nas gnang ba mdzad du gsol gyi bar lan gcig brjod cing me tog gtor te dam bca'o// drug pa rten bskyed pa ni/ gong sta gon gyi skabs ji lta ba bzhin du lha bskyed nas skye mched byin gyis brlab pa bcas bya/ de'ang rten bskyed kyi skabs 'dir phal che ba zhig thub dbang sogs bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas rnams dang ltung ba bshags pa'i sangs rgyas dang yi dam lha yang rgyud sde mang po'i lha'i sku mdog phyag mtshan sogs bskyed pa mdzad srol mchis mod/ shin tu mi 'thad de/ sangs rgyas rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs can rnams la ni/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i dbang bzhi bskur ba'i tshe rgyan can gyi lha la 'os pa'i dbang rdzas thams cad gtod dgos pa sogs mi 'tsham pa mang du snang ba'i phyir dang*/ gzhan yang bla ma yi dam chos srung nor lha rnams so sor bskyed na'ang thang kha'am lha khang gcig gi nang du lha grangs gang yod so sor ngos zin pa'ang dka' zhing*/ gal te ngos zin du rung yang lha so so'i bskyed chog kho na'ang rdzogs par dka' ba snang ba'i phyir dang*/ bskyed chog so sor rdzogs su zin na'ang rigs bdag gi rgyas 'debs mi 'chol ba zhig 'byung ba'ang dka' ba snang ba'i phyir/

gal te rten bskyed so sor bskyed pa'i dbang du btang na/ sa lugs kyi rab gnas dngos grub 'byung gter ltar dbang bzhi bskur ba'i skabs su rten dang dbang rdzas gnyis ka'i dmigs pa 'pho ba'i 'don pa bsgyur na rung mod/ de'ang rang lugs dpal 'byor rgya mtsho'i bzhed pa dang ni mi 'grigs pas so// des na rten mang nyung ji ltar yin rung yi dam gang yin gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga po bskyed pa nyid 'thad che ba mngon no// bdun pa ye shes pa spyan drangs nas dgug bstim bya ba dang*/ brgyad pa rgyas gdab pa ni/ gnas gsum du mtshan ma gsum bsgom pa rnams sta gon ltar bya'o// dgu pa dbang bskur ba ni/ slob dpon gyi mdun du dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa/ dbu rgyan rdo rje dril bu cha gnyis/ slar yang rdo rje gcig dang rdo rje dril bu cha/ gsang dbang gi rdzas kyi snod rnams bzhag la/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros sogs kyis dbang lha gdan gsum tshang ba'i rnam par spyan drangs/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs kyis mchod/ zhe sdang rdo rje sogs kyis bstod/ byang chub rdo rje sogs kyis gsol gdab rnams byas la/ dbang rdzas byin rlabs rkang thon ltar na/ dbang rdzas la las bum gyi chus gtor la/ swa bhā wa nas haṃ/ dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las mi bskyod pa kye rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa sogs kyis bskyed nas zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur gyur/ slob dpon gyis bum pa thogs te sangs rgyas rnams ni sogs nas a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐ zhes pas rten la dbang bskur ba'i tshul byas nas las kyi rdo rjes rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu rten gyi phyogs su brims pa'i tshul gyis rten gtso bo'i mdun du snod du bum chu cung zad blugs te gzhag

dbu rgyan rin chen 'byung ldan du bsgrubs nas zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas dbu rgyan du gyur/ slob dpon gyis dbu rgyan thogs te/ sangs rgyas rnams ni nas hoḥzhes dbang bskur ba'i tshul dang*/ rdo rje 'od dpag med du bsgrubs nas zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rdo rjer gyur/ rdo rje thogs te/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i nas badz+ra hūm̐ zhes dbang bskur ba'i tshul dang*/ dril bu don grub tu bsgrubs nas zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas dril bur gyur/ dril bu thogs te/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi nas s+t+waṃ/ zhes dbang bskur ba'i tshul dang*/ rdo rje dril bu rnam snang du bsgrubs nas zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rdo rje dang dril bur gyur/ de lhan cig tu thogs te/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa nas de bzhin gshegs pa'o zhes ming 'dogs pa'i tshul dang*/ yang hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rjer gyur zhes brjod la/ rdo rje thogs la 'di de sangs rgyas sogs kyis brtul bzhugs dang*/ slar yang hūm̐ dang aḥlas byung ba'i rdo rje dang dril bur gyur zhes brjod la/ rdor dril bsnol ba'i tshul dang*/ rdo rje che dang sogs nas bsdu bar gyis zhes pa ni bum dbang ngo*// gsang dbang gi rdzas nang mchod nas snod du cung zad blugs pas rten la dbang bskur ba'i tshul bya zhing*/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sogs nas hoḥzhes gsang dbang ngo*// phyag rgya gtad par bsams la/ dga' ster sogs nas dag tu gyis zhes dbang gsum pa'o// ye shes 'di ni nas/ de yi pha zhes dbang bzhi pa'o// byung rdzogs byed na/ dbang rdzas thams cad dus gcig tu bsgrubs pa dkyus su gsal ba ltar las/ ming dbang skabs rnam snang zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rdo rje dang dril bur gyur/ yang hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje dang*/ slar yang hūm̐ dang aḥlas byung ba'i rdo rje dang dril bur gyur zhes brjod na legs pa mngon no// de nas slob dpon gyis bum pa thogs la/

sangs rgyas rnams ni nas a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ dbu rgyan thogs la/ sangs rgyas rnams ni nas hoḥ rdo rje thogs te/ sangs rgyas kun gyi nas badz+ra hūm̐/ dril bu thogs te/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi nas s+t+waṃ/ rdo rje dril bu lhan cig tu thogs te/ oṃ badz+ra nas de bzhin gshegs pa'o// rdo rje thogs te/ 'di de nas hi hūm̐/ rdo rje dril bu bsnol ba'i tshul dang*/ rdo rje che dang nas bsdu bar gyis zhes bum dbang ngo*// gsang rdzas man chad snga ma bzhin bya'o// de ltar na dbang bzhi bskur bas dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las sku rten rnams la rdo rje sems dpa' sogs sta gon ltar bya'o// bcu pa mchod bstod ni/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas dbang chu ltar 'bul/ de nyid lnga pas bstod do// bcu gcig pa spyan dbye ba ni/ slob dpon gyis mig thur gyi rtser mar dang sbrang rtsi blangs nas spyan gyi phyag rgyas bzung nas rten gyi spyan g.yas g.yon du 'byed pa'i tshul dang*/ kun mkhyen ye shes nas mthu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig ces pa'i bar ro// bcu gnyis pa gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rten la mchod bstod mdor bsdus byas nas/ sngar gyi rdo rje 'chang zhu ba las byung ba'i rten so so'i rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur/ 'od dpag med rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i lung dang rtogs pa'i chos dkon mchog dbyangs dang gsal byed kyi yi ge'i rang bzhin glegs bam gyi gzugs su gyur/ mi bskyod pa zhu ba las byung ba'i rten so so'i rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur/ rin 'byung sogs yod na'ang des rigs 'gre dang*/ gzungs zhugs sam 'khor lo yod na/ 'od dpag med rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i dbyangs dang gsal byed kyi yi ge'i rang bzhin rtsa sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ nye ba'i snying po dang*/ gzungs sngags kyi tshogs su gyur ces dang*/ 'khor lo la yan chad 'dra ba las/ gzungs sngags kyi tshogs su gyur pa bris pa'i 'khor lo ji lta ba bzhin du gyur ces brjod/

'khor lo la de tsam gyis thus par bya ba'am/ khyad par gyi 'khor lo'i rab gnas lta bu dgos skabs yin na/ de dag gi steng du/ slar yang rang gi snying ga'i sa bon la 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas bris pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo'i rnam pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas bstim/ nus na 'khor lo la bkod pa'i sngags rnams kyang lan kha yang bzla'o// 'thor nas sgrub thabs gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar ram mi nus na nas gtsang ma la ye dharmā mang du bzlas nas 'bru re re nas ye dhar+m+mā'i yig 'bru gser gyi 'od 'bar ba re rer gyur par bsams pa dpon slob thams cad kyis thogs la/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sogs nas tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā zhes pa'i bar dang*/ ye dharmā brjod cing me tog 'thor ba lan gsum gyi mthar/ rgyal ba rnam par snang mdzad sogs nas bkra shis mdzad du gsol zhes brtan bzhugs bya/ rol chen dang bcas te rten rnams kyi gnas gsum du rdo rjes reg cing*/ 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol zhes brjod do// bcu gsum pa mnga' dbul la bzhi las/ dang po mchod bstod kyi mnga' dbul la/ rten gsar pa'i mdun du mchod pa bshams pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho sogs phyi mchod dang*/ yid byung gi mchod pa rnams kyis mchod de/ lha so so'i sgos bstod dang thun mong du spyi bstod kyis bstod/ gnyis pa nye bar mkho ba'i mnga' dbul la rten spyi'i mnga' dbul dang*/ rten so so'i mnga' dbul rnams dkyus ltar bya'o// gsum pa sbyin sreg gi mnga' dbul ni/ skabs 'dir rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg kho na bya ba ste/ de'i cho ga ni kye rdo rje'i rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg ji lta ba bzhin las/ 'dir mi 'dra ba'i khyad par rnams brjod pa la/

sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po la/ sbyor ba thab dang bud shing sbar ba me// rdzas dang bsham thabs sgrub pa po ste drug /ces pa ltar drug las/ dang po thab ni rab gnas kyi rten dang khad nye ba'i sa phyogs su thig chen brgyad spyi dang mthun par btab la/ rgyas pa'i thab spyi ltar bris pa'i dbus kyi pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su sku rten lha khang dang mchod rten thams cad kyi mtshon byed du/ tshon phung dbus su sngon po dang mdun nas g.yas skor gyis dkar po sogs rigs lnga'i tshon spungs dang*/ g.yas su gsung rten gyi dmar po/ g.yon du thugs rten gyi nag po gsum las gzhan mi dgos/ gnyis pa bud shing dang*/ gsum pa sbar ba me dang*/ lnga pa bsham thabs/ drug pa sgrub po rnams 'dra'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ bdag gi rnal 'byor me btsal yo byad bsang*// thab khung 'dus byas 'jig rten me lha mchod// 'das pa'i me lha mchod rnams dngos gzhi'i chos// zhes pa ltar drug las/ dang por bdag gi rnal 'byor ni/ sngon du song ma thag pa yin pas mi dgos/ gnyis pa me btsal zhing sgrub pa dang*/ gsum pa thab dang yo byad bsang ba/ bzhi pa thab khung mngon par 'du bya ba/ lnga pa 'jig rten pa'i me lhar mchod rdzas bsreg rdzas phul nas/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur ces pa'i bar 'dra'o// drug pa 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ de 'bar ba'i dbus su paṃ las sogs nas gzhal yas khang pad+ma yan chad bskyed pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rab tu gnas par byas pa'i rten gyi lha tshogs rnams las de dang 'dra ba'i lha tshogs rnams dang*/ chos kyi glegs bam rnams 'od dpag med dang*/ lha khang dang mchod rten rnams rnam par snang mdzad kyi rnam pa can gyi lha tshogs thams cad mdun gyi nam mkha' oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

zhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas spyan drangs/ spro na/ spos dang rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ dmigs med mkha' ltar dag cing khyab pa yi// chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*// thabs dang shes rab gzugs brnyan skur ston pa// bcom ldan 'khor bcas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol// zhes dang*/ ma lus sems can sogs tshigs bcad gcig gi mthar/ oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga wān sa ma ya a rtsa ma na/ ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza no pa tsar+ya pra sid+dhim+me/ zhes pas spyan drangs nas/ oṃ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ thab kyi dbus su so so'i gdan rnams kyi steng du bzhugs par gyur/ lha thams cad 'dzum zhing tshim pa 'od zer ser po 'phro ba dang*/ gzi brjid dang ldan pa'i sgo nas bdag dang sbyin bdag gis gtsor byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams dang dpal 'byor legs pa'i yon tan rnam dkar phrin las thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i las mdzad par gyur ces brjod/ phyi mchod 'dra/ nang mchod oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka he badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra ya oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yid byung lha mo brgyad kyis mchod pa'i rjes su/ bstod pa de nyid lnga pas bstod/ bsreg rdzas rnams brgya rtsa brgyad re spel tshig bdag dang sbyin bdag gis gtsor byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams dang dpal 'byor legs pa'i yon tan rnam dkar phrin las thams cad puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ zhes sbyar/ 'das gtor 'bul ba'ang des 'gre zhing gzhan thams cad 'dra/ thab kyi lha gshegs gsol gyi tshe/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can nas 'byon par mdzad du gsol zhes dang gur las 'byung ba'i yi ge brgya pa'i mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥzhes dang mtheb srin gyi se gol gyi sgra dang bcas te/ thab nang gi lha tshogs thams cad sngar bskyed pa'i rten so so la gnyis su med par thim par bsam zhing brjod do// gsum pa rjes la/

me lha lhag mas mchod dang gtor ma btang*// 'dod don zhus la gshegs gsol lhag chad bskang*// las kyi rjes bsdu ba ste drug yin no// zhes pa ltar las/ thab khung du mar blugs gzar gang dgang gzar la reg par phul la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ zhes brjod pas 'bar ba me lha zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du gyur pa sogs nas/ me lha rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam pa'i bar dkyus ji lta ba bzhin bya'o// de nas thab khung gi me'i steng du man 'ji'i khar/ tshon ser pos byugs pa'i snod bzhag la/ de'i nang du 'bras dang*/ sbrang rtsi dang*/ ka ra rnams bsres pa'i 'o ma blugs la/ thams cad kyis dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i sngags aṣ+ṭa bzla bzhin pas 'o thug bsgrubs la/ de dang tsā ru'i lha bshos bzang po rgyan gyis brgyan pa la bu ram thud la sogs pa'i zas sna bzang po dang bcas pa rgya cher bshams pa chab kyis bran te/ bsang sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lha rdzas las grub pa'i zhal zas ro brgya dang ldan pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams la/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyi brlabs nas/ las byed pa dag gis bteg cing rten la 'bul ba'i tshul bya zhing*/ zhal zas ro brgya ldan pa'i zhes sogs dang*/ oṃ di bya an+na sa mā dhi d+d+yā na pṛ ṇa

lha'i zhal zas ting 'dzin bsam gtan gyi tshim pa/ ne swā hā zhes pa lan gsum gdangs dang bcas pas 'bul lo// bzhi pa sngags kyi mnga' dbul ni/ rten la gzungs thag ser po btags pa nas bzung la/ oṃ su pra sogs brgya rtsa gcig bzla'o// de nas me tog thogs la rgyal mtshan rtse mo la sogs pa'i bkra shis kyi mnga' gsol dang mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig bya'o// gsum pa mjug gi cho ga la/ gtor ma sbyin dang chos skyong bsgo// dkyil 'khor mchod de dngos grub blang*// bzod par gsol nas gshegs su gsol// yon bdag bsgo zhing shis pa brjod// rten mchod bsod nams yongs su bsngo// slob dpon mchod de dga' ston bya// slar yang shis pa rgyas par brjod// rjes bsdu sbyin sreg mjug don no// zhes pa ltar las/ dang po gtor ma sbyin pa ni/ sgrub mchod kyi skabs ltar yi dam nas mkha' 'gro spyi gtor bar 'bul/ gnyis pa chos skyong bsgo ba ni/ gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ gur zhal gang la gtad pa de la gtor sngags kyis lan gsum mam lngas dbul/ phyi mchod dang nang mchod mthar/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la khyod kyis rab tu gnas pa sogs nas rgyun mi chad par gyis shig ces pa'i bar ro// gsum pa dkyil 'khor mchod pa ni/ rjes chog ltar mchod bstod byas la/ 'dod don dngos grub zhu'o// bzhi pa bzod par gsol zhing gshegs su gsol ba ni/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang*/ rdzogs sangs rgyas dang de sras sogs nas rang gnas bde bar gshegs su gsol zhes pa'i bar dang*/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' sogs kyis dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang*/ rten yod pa'i gtor mgron rnams la brtan bzhugs dang*/ rten med pa'i gtor mgron gshegs su gsol ba rnams bya'o// lnga pa yon bdag bsgo ba ni/ rten gyi mdun du sbyin bdag 'khor bcas 'khod pa la/

slob dpon gyis bzhengs te rten la mchod pa 'bul bar bsgo'o// drug pa shis par brjod pa ni/ sbyin bdag rnams las sngags bum pa'i chu dang bcas pas bsang*/ sbyin pa'i bdag po rnams skad cig gis he ru ka'i sku can re rer gyur ces dang*/ khro bo spyan drangs nas bgegs bskrad/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad byin gyis brlabs nas/ slob dpon gyis re re nas thogs te tshig lhug pa rnams slob dpon kho nas brjod/ tshigs bcad rnams thams cad kyis brjod cing*/ rdzas rnams rten la 'bul ba'i tshul dang*/ sbyin bdag la'ang reg par 'grim du gzhug bdun pa rten la mchod pa bya ba ni/ mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlabs nas/ rten la mchod bstod bya'o// brgyad pa bsod nams yongs su bsngo ba ni/ ji snyed su dag sogs yan lag bdun pa sngon du 'gro bas/ slob dpon gyis dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad byang chub kyi rgyur yongs su bsgyur zhing bstan pa rgyas pa sogs kyis bsngo ba smon lam rnam par dag pa'i rgyas gdab bo// skabs 'dir srid zhi'i yon tan gyis che mtho mang po gdan 'dzom pa'i dus lta bur/ spros pa la dga' zhing dge legs 'phel ba'i rten 'brel du rab gnas bzang po drug ldan gyis bshad pa byed nus pa yod na/ de la slob dpon gyis gnang ba byin nas/ des gral gyi mtha' logs shig nas 'greng ste rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa'i bshad pa dal zhing dod pa byed/ de bzhin du gzhan zhig gis phun sum tshogs pa la sogs pa dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa'i bshad pa byed pa'i srol yang yod de/ de bzhin byed pa byung na bstan pa dar ba'i dga' ston du go bas bzang ngo*// dgu pa slob dpon mchod pa dang*/ bcu pa dga' ston bya ba ni/ slob dpon yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ bzo bo las byed du bcas pa la bsnyen bkur bstabs nas/ sngar gyi tsā ru'i bza' ba drangs la/

bde gshegs lhag ma zhes pa'i tshig rkang gnyis brjod/ 'di las kyi rdo rjes brjod pa'i srol byung 'dug mod/ tshig gi shugs la brtags na/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis brjod rgyu'i tshig tu mngon pas de ltar byed pa legs par sems so// bcu gcig pa slar yang shis par brjod pa ni/ dpon slob rnams rdo rje dril bu dang bcas te/ thams cad kyis me tog thogs la/ phun sum tshogs 'dzin sogs bkra shis rgyas par bya/ rje ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i 'gro la bde skyid 'byung ba'i sgo gcig pu/ zhes bstan pa rgyas pa'i gsol 'debs dang shis brjod kyis mtha' brgyan/ de nas bkra shis la 'dus pa'i sbyin bdag las byed dang bcas pa rang gnas su btang*/ bcu gnyis pa las kyi rjes bsdu ba ni/ mchod pa dman pa sogs bsdus nas las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// bcu gsum pa sbyin sreg bya ba ni/ zhi ba'i sreg blugs blugs pa'am ma grub na/ yi ge brgya pa mang du bzla ba ste/ de dag gis ni kye rdo rje'i sgrub mchod dang 'brel ba'i rab tu gnas pa nyin gsum pa bya ba'i lugs so// nyin gcig tu rdzogs pa'i rab gnas 'bring po byed pa'i lugs la/ nang par gza' skar dus bzang 'dzom par shes pas/ de ring nas rten dang mchod gtor yo byad rnams ma tshang ba med par legs par bshams/ sang tho rengs kyi dus su rten gyi drung du 'dug ste/ bdag bskyed kye rdo rje'i lam dus kyi dbang bcas sngon du 'gro bas/ rnam rgyal bum pa dang las bum dkyil chog gi skabs ltar bsgrubs/ khrus bum rnams kyang gong bzhin bsgrubs nas/ rab gnas sta gon gyi khyad chos rnams dor ba'i/ dngos gzhi'i dus kyi sbyong khrus rnams nas brtsams te las kyi rjes bsdu ba'i bar dkyil 'khor gyi rjes chog gi khyad par ma gtogs rgyas pa'i skabs ji lta ba bzhin byas pas grub bo// smras pa/

'khor 'das bde legs 'byung gzhi dkon mchog gi /rten gsum byin rlabs rgyas pa'i mthur nges kyi// mngon zhen gyis bslangs bsag dang bsrung 'phrul gyis// bde 'dod sdug bsngal bsgrub pa'i cho gas min// rgyal gsung gdengs can dbang po'i pho brang nas// dad gsum sems kyi don mthun spyod gru yis// bsod nams yid bzhin nor bu blangs nas slar// skye dgu'i re ba bskang la de rmad byung*// rab gnas cho ga'i 'dab brgya kha 'byed la// nyer mkho'i legs bshad mtshar sdug 'gram chang 'di// legs par bskrun pa'i dge bas stobs bcu pa'i// bstan pa phyogs dus kun du dar gyur cig /ces rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga dpal 'byor rgya mtsho'i 'don brjod la nye bar mkho ba'i zur rgyan mtshar sdug 'gram chang zhes bya ba 'di ni/ skye sku don grub gling gi bshes gnyen lhun grub rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ngo ma ldog tsam du/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas mtshan mo snang gsal gyi 'od la brten nas bris pa la/ slar yang rab byung bcu gsum pa'i ya gyal rnam gnon zhes pa'i gnam lor zhus dag gi tshul gyis tshig sna cung zad bsring ste/ rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gi khyad par dang bcas te/ dpal lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab kyi dbang po'i phyogs kyi ba gam gsum par sug bris su bgyis pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// // ༄༅// rten gsar rnying la bya ba ar+gha'i cho ga mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// rnam lnga'i rigs kyi ri gling ma lus par// rigs mchog gser gyi tsakras dbang bsgyur ba// bla ma rdo rje sems dpar gtsug mchod nas// gsar rnying rten gyi ar+gha'i cho ga 'dri// de'ang rten gsar pa la bya ba'i ar+gha'i cho ga dang*/ rten rnying pa la bya ba'i ar+gha'i cho ga gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten gang du bzheng pa'i sar sa'i cho ga rgyas par byas/

de'i rjes bris sku yin na ras 'dul byas pa dang*/ glegs bam 'dri na shog bu'i po ti'i drung der mchod pa chu bzhi'am chu gnyis gang dang 'brel ba dang*/ gtor ma gcig gam lnga sogs gang rung bsham/ rang kye rdo rje'am yi dam gyi lha gang rung gi bsgom bzlas rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs par byas la/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas bzhag rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma yi dam rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs la/ oṃ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes pas gdan phul/ mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho sogs tshigs bcad dang bcas pa'am/ mi nus na/ oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra sngon du 'gro bas ni ri hūm̐ khaṃ sogs chu bzhi'am chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo'i bar gyis mchod/ bstod pa sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku sogs dang*/ chos sku nam mkha' sogs dang*/ mthun pa'i smon lam sogs dang*/ 'jam dbyangs phyag na rdo rje sogs dang*/ rdzu 'phrul stobs sogs dang*/ nor gyi dbang phyug la sogs pas bstod pa'am/ mi nus na/ de nyid lnga pa'am/ snang stong rdo rje'i sogs spyi bstod gang rung gis bstod pa/ rten bzheng bar bya ba 'di dag la byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol snyam pas/ spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ye shes lha tshogs bcom ldan 'das// rig pa'i rgyal por phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rje'i bdag nyid rten bzheng bar// kun gyis byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir// rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis ni// sbyin bdag rnams la brtse ba dang*// khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir// yo byad ci 'byor pa dag gis// mchod rten gsar par 'chos par 'tshal// tshogs pa thams cad rten bzheng bar// kun gyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes lan gsum dang*/

de'ang 'di ltar bla ma yi dam rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ 'dir bdag gis sems can thams cad la gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan pa bla na med pa bsgrub pa'i ched du/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po bskrun par 'tshal na/ gtsug lag khang chen po dkon mchog gsum gyi rten bsam gyis mi khyab pas gang ba cig 'byung bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes pa'am/ sku gzugs dang mchod rten gang yin yang rung bar bsgrub pa'i ched du zhes pa yan chad sngar bzhin la/ 'dir bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel gyi snying po can gyi mchod rten chen po bskrun par 'tshal na/ mchod rten chen po byin rlabs dang ldan pa cig 'byung bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes brjod/ bris sku dang chos kyi glegs bam yin na/ 'dir bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa'i bris sku'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung rab rin po che 'dri bar 'tshal na/ bris sku de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pas gang ba cig 'byung bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes sam/ gsung rab la lung dang rtogs pa'i chos dkon mchog dbyangs dang gsal byed kyi yi ge'i rnam pa can gyi glegs bam du 'byung bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes gsol ba gdab/ de nas gtor ma yi dam gang rung gi gzhung ltar byin gyis brlabs/ yi dam dang chos skyong so so'i gtor ma phul ba'i mthar tshigs bcad rnams mi brjod par/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ 'dir bdag gis sems can thams cad man chad gong ltar skabs su gang babs kyi gsol ba gdab pa rnams gong ltar bya/ lha bzo ba dang yig mkhan bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las khyed rnams las kyi khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sku mdog ljang sngon sogs zhal phyag rang rang gi bum bskyed ltar gsal btab la/

de'i dpral bar oṃ sogs sam mig tu gti mug rdo rje la sogs skabs su gang babs ltar byin gyis brlabs/ tshon dang pir dang snag tsha dang*/ smyu gu rnams la'ang*/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis phog pas/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/ bcom ldan 'das kyi rtsa sngags sogs yi dam gang yin gyi sngags dang las sngags kha yar bzlas pas byin gyis brlab bo// slar yang nam mkhar bzhugs pa rnams la mchod bstod mdor bsdus byas nas 'dod don gsol ba btab nas/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol nas/ oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes pas de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ rang gi gnas bsrung ba sogs bya'o// rten gsar pa la bya ba'i ar+gha'i cho ga'o// //gnyis pa rten rnying pa la bya ba'i ar+gha'i cho ga la/ slob dpon ār+ya de bas sems kyi sgrib sbyong las/ mchod rten gso ba'i bsam pa yis// bshig par gyur la nyes pa med// ces gsungs te/ de'ang brten ngan pa bzang por spo ba dang*/ dma' ba'am 'o brgyal ba'i gnas nas 'o mi brgyal ba'i gnas su spo ba dang*/ rnying pa gso ba rnams rung gi gzhan la ni mi rung gsung ngo*// ji ltar bya ba'i cho ga ni lha sta gon dang*/ dngos gzhi gnyis byed pa'am/ mi nus na dngos gzhi kho na bya ste/ dang po ltar na rten de'i drung du kye rdo rje yi dam du byed na/ chu bzhi nyer spyod dang*/ gzhan dang 'brel na chu gnyis sogs skabs su gang bab dang*/ gtor ma lnga tshar sogs gang 'os bsham/ rang yi dam gang rung ngam/ kye rdo rje'i lam dus kyi bsgom bzlas rdzogs par byas/ mchod pa bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs/ rten rnying pa rnams bla ma yi dam rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad 'dus pa'i rang bzhin de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i rnam pa can du bzhugs pa la mchod par mos te/

rab 'byams rgya mtsho sogs tshigs bcad dang*/ oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra'am/ oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta oṃ ni ri re re'i sngon du 'gro bas ni ri hūm̐ khaṃ swā hā nas shab+da āḥhūm̐ zhes rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ rten so so'i bstod pa'am mi shes na de nyid lnga pa'am snang stong rdo rje sogs spyi bstod gang rung gis bstod la/ rten rnying pa'i rab gnas nangs par spo bar 'tshal gyi bdag la rjes su gnang bar mdzad du gsol snyam pas/ ye shes lha tshogs sogs gong ltar las/ thugs rje'i bdag nyid rten 'chos par// kun gyis rjes su gnang ba'i phyir// zhes dang*/ tshogs pa thams cad rten 'chos par// kun gyis nangs par gnang ba mdzod// ces bsgyur te brjod pa dang*/ bla ma yi dam rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i tshogs thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag gis sems can thams cad la gnas skabs mthar thug gi phan bde bla na med pa bsgrub pa'i ched du/ bde bar gshegs pa'i rten gsar pa bskrun pa'i phyir rten rnying pa'i rab gnas spo bar 'tshal zhing*/ de'ang sang nangs par bgyid par 'tshal na/ thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can thams cad kyis bdag la rjes su gnang ba mdzad du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pa la/ de dag gi zhal nas rig pa 'dzin pa khyod las de ci bde bar gyis shig ces gnang ba nod par bsams la rang gis brjod do// de nas gtor ma bran te nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs nas mdzes rgyan ltar kye rdo rje la sogs pa'i yi dam rnams la gtor ma phul nas bstod pa dang 'dod don zhus pa'i mthar/ yi dam la'ang dgongs gsol nas rig pa 'dzin pa khyod las de ci bde bar gyis shig ces gnang ba nod pa'i bar gong bzhin bya/ gur zhal la sogs pa chos srung so so'i gtor ma phul nas bshad sgrub bstan pa rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod ces pa lta bu'i rjes su bstan srung dam tshig can gyi tshogs thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/

bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du sogs man chad gong bzhin sbyar ro// mkha' 'gro spyi gtor la'ang yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod/ ces pa'i rjes su mkha' 'gro dam tshig can gyi tshigs thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol bdag gis sogs 'dra bar brjod do// de nas rdo rje'i glu sogs gtor chog gi mjug gi bya ba rnams bya'o// de dag ni sta gon nam snyan gsan 'bebs pa yin no// sang nyin dngos gzhi la rten gyi mdun du mchod gtor sngar bzhin bshams la/ bdag gi rnal 'byor rdzogs par byas nas dkon mchog spyi la mchod pa 'bul ba dang*/ yi dam dang chos skyong nas mkha' 'gro spyi gtor bar thams cad snga ma ji lta ba bzhin la khyad par ni/ gsol gdab rnams kyi tshe nangs par zhes pa'i tshab tu kun gyis da ltar gnang ba mdzod ces/ de'ang da ltar bgyid par 'tshal na zhes bsgyur la gsol ba gdab/ de nas me long g.ya' yongs su dag pa cig smyug ma la btags pa rten gyi drung du btsugs te/ gzugs brnyan 'char du bcug la 'di ltar bsams te/ rten 'di gang zag khyad par can gyis rab tu gnas pa byas pa yin na'ang me long gi gzugs brnyan la spo bar rung ste/ de'i rgyu mtshan rten 'di bden na me long gi nang gi gzugs brnyan yang bden/ me long gi nang gi gzugs brnyan yang mi bden na/ rten 'di yang mi bden pa'i phyir te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis chos thams cad me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar mi bden par gsungs pa'i phyir ro snyam du yun ring du bsam zhing brjod la/ de nas me long nang gi gzugs brnyan de nyid la rten dam tshig pa bskyed de/ de'ang sku'i rten gcig pu'am gnyis gsum lta bu bskyed nus pa yin na de ltar du bskyed cing lha khang lta bu lha mang po yod pa yin na bsang sbyangs/ sku'i rten thams cad mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ las rdo rje oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa las rdo rje 'chang kye rdo rje sku mdog dkar po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa sogs kyis yum rdo rje snyems ma dang bcas pa rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga bskyed/ de bzhin du gsung rten gyi rigs yin na 'od dpag med dang*/ thugs rten yin na mi bskyod pa dang*/ mchod rten yin na rnam snang sogs su bskyed la/ de thams cad kyi mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs kyis gnas dang skye mched byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas rten rnying pa'i ye shes pa rang 'dra ba dang*/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs nas me long gi nang du bskyed pa la/ oṃ badz+ra gau ri ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥsogs sgo ba bzhi'i sngags rgya dang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pa yang yang brjod pas bstim/ de la mchod bstod gong ltar bsdus pa byas me tog thogs te/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i sogs nas bye brag tu rten 'di nyid la spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs thams cad ji srid rten gsar pa la spyan 'dren ma byas kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol zhes dang*/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha sogs kyis me tog gtor ro// me long gi steng 'og mi 'khrul pa'i mtshan ma byas te/ dar ser pos g.yogs pa'i rgyab ngos su mdud pa 'ong bar byas la de'i steng la ca la rgyas btab ste/ rten gsar pa'i rab gnas byed byed du kha mi dbye bar mchod pa dang bcas te dben par gzhag go /rten rnying pa'i sa rdo nas gsar pa la bsre ba'am chur gnas skye bo rnams la phan phyir chu nang du blugs pa'am mchod rten lta bur bskrun pa gang rung bya'o// rten gsar par rab gnas kyi ye shes pa gzhug pa'i tshe me long kha phye ste/

de'i nang du bskyed cing spyan drangs pa rnams kyang rten gsar pa la gzhug cho ga gzhan rnams rab gnas kyi dkyus bzhin du bya'o// 'di dag ni kye rdo rje dang 'brel ba'i dbang du byas pa yin/ yi dam gzhan gang yang rung ba dang sbyar du rung bas/ de'i tshe mchod pa chu gnyis nyer spyod bsham dbul dang*/ rigs lnga'i lha bskyed dang gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs pa sogs rang rang gi gzhung ltar byas pas don grub bo// 'dir smras pa/ dpal mchog rdo rje 'chang ba sa skya pa'i// legs gsungs dka' gnas tshig gi rdo rje'i rgyar// sbas don dpyad gsum rnam dag sor mo'i rtses// 'grel byed res su son pa bla ma'i drin// 'di tshul legs par ma shes sngon rabs kyi// mkhas dang grub pa'i byin rlabs mchod rten gzhig /gnyer gtad lha srung khros pas tshe 'dir 'tshe// mtshams med las kyi slad mar mi bder byed// de slad 'dis kyang dad sgrol gong ma'i gsung*// sngo bsangs mel tshe'i gnyen por nyin byed bzhin// srid pa'i mkha' dkyil brtan byas dge ba yang*// shes bya thams cad gzigs pa'i rgyur bsngo'o// zhes rten gsar rnying la bya ba ar+gha'i cho ga mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba 'di ni/ don du gnyer ba 'gas bskul ba'i ngor/ rje btsun e waṃ pa chen po'i legs bshad kyi bdud rtsis 'tsho ba'i ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu bris pa dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
